Matching extended attack and raised rally stationary holds shortened; original timestamps preserved. Attack contact source42/index30; rally source37/index13. Runtime move50ms, attack/hit/death33ms, defend/rally42ms. Every native and mirrored phase inspected at actual128px reference height, with actual battle-clock captures covering strike contact and recovery.
